cells.unobservable: The unread badge is a bare number with no aria-label and no role; its accessible text is the count itself. This cell asserts the rendered count and the 99+ clamp, not that a screen reader announces the number as an unread count.

checks.name: the composer exposes a named "Attach file" control
a refused upload tells the writer and attaches nothing to the draft
the upload was attempted exactly once and was intercepted, not delivered

cells.unobservable: Upload failures are Sonner toasts only. There is no inline error node, no role=alert and no per-file retry control, so this cell reads the toast region; the retry gesture is re-selecting the file.

checks.name: "Load older messages" reached the server cursor after 1 press(es) and rendered the older page
a long channel introduces no horizontal overflow

cells.unobservable: `hasNextPage` passed to the message list is `hasNextPage || hasOlderHeld` and the first presses widen a purely client-side render window (MESSAGE_RENDER_PAGE_SIZE = 60) before any network page is requested, so the press count before the cursored request is recorded rather than asserted.
